Congress Criticizes Government's UPI Decision, Citing US Pressure

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has criticized the government's decision regarding UPI, alleging it amounts to surrendering to US pressure. He claimed the move opens the door to charges. The specific nature of the UPI decision and the alleged charges were not detailed in the coverage. Gandhi's statements were reported by centrist and right-leaning outlets.
